en.headline: Sun says foreign carer trial to start in second half of next year
en.dek: The labour chief said the first intake would be several hundred people, each trained for more than 150 hours.
body: Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun said a trial scheme to bring in foreign domestic carers with elderly-care training is expected to start in the second half of next year, RTHK reported.

Sun said Hong Kong has about 380,000 foreign domestic helpers, mostly doing household work. The new carers would have specialist elderly-care skills and could also handle other household tasks. He said the first intake would be several hundred people, all required to complete more than 150 hours of training in their home countries.

He said the Social Welfare Department currently subsidises training of a little more than 1,000 helpers for about a dozen hours, covering basics such as first aid and help with medicine. The new course would follow the level of a care worker in a residential home, and professional bodies appointed by the government would help design and accredit the courses overseas. Sun said the minimum wage for the carers would be 10 to 20 per cent higher than the current helper rate, with adjustments referencing the helper wage system.

zh.headline: 孫玉菡：外籍家居照顧員擬明年下半年試行
zh.dek: 勞福局局長說初期引入數百人，須在原居地接受逾150小時培訓。
body: 勞工及福利局局長孫玉菡表示，參照外傭制度試行輸入外籍家居照顧員的措施，預計明年下半年開始，初期引入數百人。港台報道，他們全部要在原居地接受超過150小時培訓。
孫玉菡在電視節目說，本港現有約38萬名外傭，主要處理家居事務。新引入的照顧員須具備專項護老技能，同時可以處理其他家居事務。他說香港高齡人口增加，經考核的護老人手有助應付居家照顧需要。
他指出，社署現時資助約一千多名外傭接受十多小時培訓，內容包括急救及協助服藥等基本知識。日後課程會參照院舍保健員，程度較高，並由特區政府委任的專業機構協助當地設計及認證。最低工資水平將較現時外傭高一至兩成，調整機制亦參考外傭工資制度。
